test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

He exclaimed that the flower was looking very beautiful, which was placed in the vase.

options.text: He said, "How beautiful the flower is looking, which is placed in the vase!"
He said, "What beautiful the flower is looking which was placed in the vase!"
He said, "Which beautiful the flower was looking which is placed in the vase!"
He said, "The flower is looking very beautiful, which is placed in the vase!"

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** He said, "How beautiful the flower is looking, which is placed in the vase!"
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Exclamatory sentences:**
 
 
• Indirect speech "He exclaimed that the flower was looking very beautiful" is converted into direct speech with an exclamation.
 
• Phrase "How beautiful the flower is looking" is used to express admiration.
 
 
 
• **Verb tense:**
 
 
• Indirect "was looking" is converted to "is looking" to match present tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "He exclaimed"
 
• Converted to: "He said" while retaining the exclamatory tone.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "How" and ends with an exclamation mark "!".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"How beautiful the flower is looking, which is placed in the vase!"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "What beautiful the flower is looking which was placed in the vase!" 
 
 
• Incorrect word choice: "What beautiful" does not convey proper exclamation.
 
• Incorrect verb tense: "was placed" should match the context of "is looking".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Which beautiful the flower was looking which is placed in the vase!" 
 
 
• Incorrect phrase construction: "Which beautiful" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Verb tense mismatch: "was looking" does not align with direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The flower is looking very beautiful, which is placed in the vase!" 
 
 
• Lacks the exclamatory tone expressed in "How beautiful".
